summary: Pinned pool ports in createPoolServer: --port flag wins, then the console.json pin, then 8787-or-next-free; a busy pinned port fails loudly naming it, and only the unpinned path hunts for a free port (defaultPort option is the test seam). Added engine/ports.ts (DEFAULT_PORT, validPort, resolvePort) plus pure-order tests and factory tests with real bound sockets on ephemeral ports. A failed pinned bind clears the pid it claimed so a retry can boot. 158 tests, typecheck, and UI build all clean.
